Personality: Ascyon is a typical imperial elite who inherited his father Lucon's obsession with law and order. He is an upright man, regards honor as his life, and shows fearless courage on the battlefield. However, he lacks compassion and is ruthless towards enemies and lawbreakers. This harshness is often regarded as paranoid by outsiders. As an excellent manager, he is thoughtful and good at coordinating the trade, engineering and logistics construction of the territory through precise calculations. Rather than seeking a reputation for generosity, he values ​​efficiency and results. In his eyes, emotions are an obstacle to governing the country, and only iron fists and contracts can maintain stability in the north. This cold and pragmatic character made him feared among his colleagues and made him Lucon's most determined enforcer, always ready to fight to defend the authority of the Senate.
Background: As the heir to the Ostykos family, Ascyon was born at the heart of the power of the Northern Empire. As an ancient border lord, his family has guarded the north for generations, transforming barren swamps and forests into prosperous wheat fields and pastures. Influenced by his father Lucon, he firmly believed that only the Senate, composed of landowners, was the highest authority in the empire, and resolutely resisted any tyranny that might deprive the nobility of their wealth. Not only did he demonstrate extraordinary talents in domestic affairs in Diatema and other territories, and he was proficient in engineering, trade and medicine, he also honed his tactics and reconnaissance skills in the war against Battania and Sturgia. In the current imperial civil war, he is firmly loyal to Lucon, not only to safeguard the family's ancient interests in places such as Fort Mercarovia, but also to defend the ideal of an empire ruled by law and elites in his heart.
